INFLUXDB3_HOST_URL.description: Where your instance answers. An address. InfluxDB still reads the older INFLUX_HOST as a fallback.

INFLUXDB3_DATABASE_NAME.description: Which database. A name, with INFLUX_DATABASE as the older fallback.

INFLUXDB3_AUTH_TOKEN.description: InfluxDB says to keep database tokens in a secure secret store, and that a token string is viewable only at creation because InfluxDB does not store it. A lost one is deleted and replaced. Older fallback: INFLUX_TOKEN.
